finalReading.passage: Last year, a teenage girl built a simple alarm to help her deaf grandfather. When the doorbell rings, a bright light has been set to flash across every room. The quiet invention has already made the old man feel much safer at home.

questions.q: Why did the girl build the alarm?
options: To help her grandfather who cannot hear.
To win a prize at her school.
To sell it to the neighbours.
To wake people up in the morning.
questions.explanation: 原文'to help her deaf grandfather'的转述;其余与原文相反或未提。

questions.q: What happens when the doorbell rings?
options: A bright light flashes in the rooms.
A bell rings outside the house.
questions.explanation: 原文'a bright light has been set to flash across every room'的转述(短文中段,覆盖不同位置)。
